'''Hereven Kev''' was a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who was [[Reproduction/Legends|born]] to [[Dayla Kev]] and [[Hereven]], two [[Scout/Legends|scouts]] who were stranded on a hostile jungle [[Planet/Legends|world]]. The elder Hereven was [[Death/Legends|killed]] while hunting during Dayla's pregnancy, and she brought up her son alone, raising him to despise the scout [[Milac Troper]], who had abandoned Dayla and the elder Hereven to [[Death/Legends|die]] on the world. Over the next [[Standard decade/Legends|decade]], Hereven and his mother faced many ordeals as the struggled to survive and they consequently became more closely attuned to [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. When Hereven was in his teens, he and his mother were rescued from the jungle world by the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] outlaws [[Fahraark]] and [[Friyahrr]]. Though the Wookiees initially planned to sell the pair into [[Slavery/Legends|slavery]], Dayla persuade them to work with her instead, and the Kevs and the two Wookiees subsequently established a small safari outfitting and wilderness guide company.<ref name="GC6" />

Over the [[Standard year/Legends|years]], Hereven's desire for revenge against Troper drove him to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]] and he eventually became a [[dark side marauder]]. About twenty-five [[Standard year/Legends|years]] after their rescue, Hereven and his mother hatched a plan to get back at Troper for the suffering that he had caused to them. During a peace conference that Troper was attending aboard the [[Ithorian Herdship]] ''[[Galactic Horizon]]'', the Krevs and their Wookiee associates released various dangerous creatures aboard the [[Starship/Legends|vessel]], driving Troper and his entourage deep into the heart of the herdship biosphere, while under constant attack. Hereven observed Troper's struggle via a [[Viewscreen/Legends|viewscreen]] and twenty-four [[Standard hour/Legends|hours]] after Troper's ordeal had commenced, the Krevs confronted him in person and Hereven engaged in combat with Troper's security team.<ref name="GC6" />
